### Endless Love?
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-april-16-11628972.html
Passage: Song of Solomon 4:7
Points:
- God designed marriage and romantic affection to bring lasting joy, delight, and fulfillment.
- Although couples encounter trials and friction, the honeymoon spirit does not have to end after returning home.
- Marital drift and emotional distance occur when partners stop following God's ways.
- Struggling couples should discard pride and promptly seek outside help or counseling.
- Taking steps of faith allows God to heal and renew a hurting relationship.

### Do You Know What God Thinks about Sex?
Author: Dr. David Jeremiah
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/do-you-know-what-god-thinks-about-sex.html
Passage: Song of Solomon 4:1-5:1
Points:
- Physical intimacy within marriage was authored by God and receives His complete blessing.
- Intimacy flourishes when a husband takes time to tenderly affirm his wife's beauty.
- Lasting satisfaction comes from focusing on your spouse's needs rather than your own.
- Waiting for marriage preserves intimacy as a private, treasured garden meant solely for one's spouse.
- Mutual devotion and patience lead to shared joy and holy freedom in the marital union.
